title: MadEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization of Trading Systems with Large Language Models
central_strategy: Use multiple frontier LLMs across five evolutionary islands to mutate both a BTCUSD alpha forecaster and its trading-system code through differential patches and holistic rewrites; retain diverse elites with MAP-Elites, migrate candidates every five generations, and select the best evolved program under a limit-order simulator with explicit fill, fee, and market-impact mechanics.

official_framework.attribution: The manuscript links the framework site, which links coauthor Tianyi Li's repository.

preserved_components: General differential-patch and holistic-rewrite mutation machinery.
MAP-Elites partitioning, island migration, elite-vault, and SQLite artifact-lineage components.
Native and Slurm execution orchestration in the general framework.
required_but_missing: The BTCUSD/Polygon OHLCV adapter, frozen market snapshot, alpha forecaster, trading-system implementation, and complete simulator/evaluator.
The five paper configurations, initial programs, random seeds, model routing probabilities, prompts, requests/responses, candidates, lineages, and run reports.
The best evolved strategy code, feature programs, 200-proposal Claude Code trees, successful candidates, and selection traces.
The two 120-trial Optuna studies, trial tables, parameters, objective arrays, and chosen settings.
Orders, fills, inventory, fees, market-impact states, holdings, returns, baselines, table arrays, and plot arrays.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_framework_is_not_a_strategy: The released package is domain-general evolutionary infrastructure and contains no trading-specific code, candidate, score, or portfolio. Its five synthetic component checks cannot emit a market action.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_appendix_skeleton_is_insufficient: The paper's baseline pseudocode has omissions and unresolved project-specific classes/data; it is neither the evolved headline program nor a standalone score-producing baseline.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_cannot_fill_the_gap: JKP can provide a common monthly U.S. panel, but there is no released MadEvolve candidate program to run on it. Designing a new factor, simulator, objective, and evolution search would create a new system rather than transfer the paper's strategy.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_btc_execution_cannot_be_silently_rep: The paper makes limit-order fill, fee, and market-impact mechanics part of the optimized trading system. Replacing them with a generic monthly decile score would discard the object that MadEvolve evolves.

closure_rule: Do not promote general framework fixtures, appendix pseudocode, a newly designed JKP evolution problem, or reconstructed plot curves to MadEvolve. Reopen for attributable trading code, evolved candidate programs, or paper run lineage.
